levelConvention: L is effective skill level; formulas use base + growth * L (not L-1).
integration: No native IDs, hooks, live tables or skill slots have been changed. Tested standalone gameplay engine; native adapter, artwork, tooltips and in-game validation follow after slot selection.
procPolicy: Every damaging skill may request on-hit procs on successful native hits. Secondary hits cannot recursively start Afterimage or mark explosions. Proc-generated damage never feeds Death Mark.

skills.name: Expose Weakness
skills.mechanics: Successful hits against full-life enemies always critically strike. Critical damage bonus: 10 + L percentage points. Native Critical Strike / Deadly Strike must not multiply the same hit twice.

skills.name: Omnislash
skills.mechanics: Randomly jump between nearby enemies, allowing repeated targets. 5 + floor(L/5) hits; 200 + 25L% weapon damage per hit; +200 + 20L% attack rating; 10-second cooldown.
provisional: 8-yard search radius; one jump every 5 frames; traversable landing positions required.

skills.name: Queen of Blades
skills.mechanics: Every second, launch blades at nearby enemies. Each blade: 30 + 5L% weapon damage; +100 + 10L% attack rating. Intended replacement: Blade Shield, not assigned yet.
provisional: 15 + 3L mana before reservation efficiency; 8-yard range; up to 3 + floor(L/10) targets, capped at 8.

skills.name: ATMG Sentry
skills.mechanics: Fire 8 shots per second. Each shot: 10 + L% weapon damage; +100 + 10L% attack rating. Successful hits can trigger on-hit effects.
provisional: 8-yard range; 80 shots per sentry; up to 5 sentries. Overclock consumes the shot budget faster.

skills.name: Spiked Ground
skills.mechanics: Movement leaves overlapping spike patches. Each patch lasts 3 seconds and hits once per second for 25 + 5L% weapon damage; +100 + 10L% attack rating. Patches stack independently.
provisional: 15 + 3L mana before efficiency; one patch per 0.2 seconds while moving; 1-yard patch radius; first hit after 1 second.

skills.name: Afterimage
skills.mechanics: Successful primary attacks leave an afterimage that strikes the same target after a short delay for 30 + 3L% weapon damage. Afterimages can trigger on-hit effects but cannot spawn further afterimages.
provisional: 15 + 3L mana before efficiency; 6-frame delay (0.24 seconds); inherits the initiating attack-rating bonus.

skills.name: Death Mark
skills.mechanics: Primary successful hits mark a target for 5 seconds. Store the actual damage dealt by the owner and their owned attacks; release 100% of the stored damage as a physical area explosion on expiry or earlier death. Later hits do not refresh the timer. Death Mark explosions do not feed other Death Marks.
provisional: 15 + 3L mana before efficiency; 6-yard explosion radius. Marked targets stop collecting when the buff is disabled.

skills.name: Gravity Trap
skills.mechanics: Periodically pull enemies toward the trap and slow enemies inside its area. Bosses and movement-immune enemies keep their native movement restrictions.
provisional: 8-second lifetime; 6-yard radius; pull once per second; movement slow 20 + L%, capped at 60%; strongest overlapping slow wins; up to 5 traps.

skills.name: Overclock
skills.mechanics: Increase sentry firing speed, consuming available shots faster. Does not accelerate Queen of Blades or Spiked Ground beyond their one-second damage cadence.
provisional: 15 + 3L mana before efficiency; +25 + 2L% sentry firing rate.
